d:
Amar is an honest inspector whose family is killed by Jaimal, a gangster. The gangster assumes Amar to be dead, but he is in coma. When he wakes up, he avenges the death of his family. When he exits coma, he takes revenge by murdering the villains one by one to avenge his loved ones who died at the hands of the villains.
Movie:- Cheetah (1994) | chita
StarCast:- Mithun Chakraborty, Ashwini Bhave, Prem Chopra, Gulshan Grover, Raza Murad
Directed By:- Harmesh Malhotra
Produced By:- Rajiv Babbar
Music By:- Jatin Lalit
